scan_table_check.description:
Flags Scripted REST resources (sys_ws_operation) with "Requires authentication" turned off: anyone who can reach the instance can call them without logging in. The finding is recorded against the resource itself.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Scripted REST API without Authentication".
scan_table_check.name: SN-REST-001: Scripted REST resource without authentication
scan_table_check.resolution_details: Turn on "Requires authentication" and control access with ACLs and "Requires ACL authorization". Leave it off only for endpoints deliberately meant to be public, and mute this finding with the reason.
scan_table_check.short_description: A Scripted REST resource has "Requires authentication" turned off.
scan_table_check.sys_name: SN-REST-001: Scripted REST resource without authentication
